friction_points: P1-FRICTION-1 [P3]: Wrong-branch-or-no-branch fallback message reuses `composer.preview_unavailable` translation key (LoginController:85). A new cashier without branch assignment sees 'Aperçu indisponible' rather than 'Aucune filiale assignée — contactez l’admin'. Confusing on first login attempt. Recommended: dedicated `auth.no_branch_assigned` key.

P1-FRICTION-2 [P4]: No 'remember me' / 'stay signed in' checkbox visible — every shift opening requires retyping credentials. Sanctum token TTL 480 min covers a long shift but session is destroyed on browser close (Auth::guard('web')->logout() at L146 immediately after attempt). Cashier on a shared terminal with auto-close browser will retype daily.

friction_points: P12-CRITICAL-GAP [P0 V1]: Cashiers have NO UI to perform Z-close at end of shift. Only the safety-net cron protects fiscal closure. This violates the NF525 best-practice of operator-initiated daily Z-close — and creates a daily race where the cron MUST fire correctly or the day rolls over unsealed (Y+1 day starts before Y is closed). Recommend V1.0.X PROPOSAL approval + implementation: add 'Clôturer la journée' button in PosComponent header (similar to Caisse but distinct icon) that opens confirmation modal showing day totals + final-cash-count + 'Imprimer Z' CTA.

P12-FRICTION-1 [P1]: LastZReportWidget on dashboard only shows AFTER-THE-FACT — cashier cannot SEE 'a Z-close is pending today' in the POS surface. Recommend: visible indicator on POS header when last Z-close is > 18h ago (or similar threshold).

cross_flows.title: Direct sale + parallel kiosk-cash encaissement
cross_flows.evidence: PosOrdersTracker + Q10 panels update via polling independently of the current cart state (PosComponent posCart Vuex module separate from kiosk-cash list). 2 simultaneous flows: cashier types in cart at the same time PosCounterCollectModal opens (triggered by clicking Encaisser on Q10 panel). Modal is independent transitional overlay — does NOT mutate posCart.
cross_flows.race: Per H.2.7 — two cashiers using DIFFERENT idempotency keys for the SAME logical order create distinct Order rows but each independently allocates its own fiscal_sequence_no (no double-allocation). Per H2-HEAL-01 — fixed cross-cashier idempotency leak via (branch_id, user_id, hash(key)) UNIQUE constraint.
cross_flows.Q10_independent_updates: YES — readyOrders + kioskCashOrders separate computed sources, polling independent of cart mutations.
cross_flows.concern: If the cashier is mid-cart and clicks Encaisser on a Q10 kiosk-cash order, PosCounterCollectModal opens OVER the cart. Closing the modal returns cart intact. No state leak observed.

cross_flows.title: Multiple orders queued (5+)
cross_flows.evidence: Q10 panels slice .slice(0, 4) — shows MAX 4 rows + 'Voir plus' link/button (PosComponent.vue:316-323 + 380-388). Overflow routes to PosOrdersTracker (ready) or opens showKioskCashPanel slide-in (cash).
cross_flows.visual_clarity: Each row shows N° queue_number + price + 1-click CTA — compact. Empty state has 'Mis à jour il y a Xs' health beacon.
cross_flows.pagination: After 4 visible, link to full tracker page. NO inline pagination/scroll within the panel.
cross_flows.concern: Rush 19h-21h with 8+ orders may hide critical ones below the cut. Recommend bumping slice to 6 OR auto-scroll within panel with max-height + overflow-y.

cross_flows.title: Mobile/tablet POS view
cross_flows.evidence: Cart panel: `md:w-[340px] lg:w-[360px] xl:w-[400px]` + full-screen overlay below md (PosComponent.vue:505). Mobile-only close button + floating bottom 'View cart' bar (PosComponent.vue:1140). CSS media queries at 767px + 640px breakpoints. Header buttons hide labels below `lg:` breakpoint (1024px).
cross_flows.portrait_landscape: No explicit landscape detection. iPad portrait (768x1024) = md breakpoint, cart visible 340px. iPad landscape (1024x768) = lg, cart 360px.
cross_flows.touch_targets: Most buttons are PosV5Button size='md' which renders >= 40px. Header icons (32x32 inside 40px button) likely meet 44px target but need empirical verification. Q10 'Encaisser' / 'Livré' CTAs render as small inline buttons (need measure).
cross_flows.concern: P3-FRICTION-2 — header buttons hide labels on tablet portrait (768px width is hidden lg:inline). Cashier on a 10'' tablet sees ICONS ONLY for 5 header buttons. Tooltips (title attr) help but require long-press on touchscreens (not native).
friction_points: CF3-FRICTION-1 [P3]: lg:inline cutoff at 1024px = hides labels on most tablets. Recommend md:inline cutoff (768px) OR mandatory tooltip overlay on first tablet boot.
CF3-FRICTION-2 [P3]: Q10 panel CTAs are 32-36px height (PosV5 sm-size). Cashier with thick fingers in rush may misclick adjacent rows. Recommend bumping to size='md' (40px+) on tablet breakpoint.

top_10_cashier_friction_points.summary: NO UI button to initiate NF525-compliant refund counter-entry. Backend route + service ready but ZERO Vue caller. Cashiers WILL use cancel-with-reason instead, leaving fiscal books unbalanced.
top_10_cashier_friction_points.recommendation: Add 'Rembourser' button to tracker row that opens reason-input modal + invokes POST /refund-with-counter-entry.

top_10_cashier_friction_points.summary: NO UI button to perform Z-close at end of shift. Only safety-net cron protects fiscal closure. Operator-initiated daily Z-close is NF525 best practice + the only path for the cashier to print a Z-report at end of day.
top_10_cashier_friction_points.recommendation: Approve PROPOSAL Z-close Vue UI button + ship it. Header CTA 'Clôturer la journée' opens confirmation modal.

top_10_cashier_friction_points.summary: ZERO keyboard shortcuts in POS (only Enter/Space on ItemComponent grid). Power users in rush 19-21h need F1=cash, F2=card, ESC=cancel, Ctrl+Shift+Z=close.
No Enter-to-confirm in PaymentComponent. Cashier types amount then must mouse-click ✓ Confirmer.
top_10_cashier_friction_points.recommendation: Bind Enter on cashInput/cardInput fields to confirm action when canConfirm computed is true.

top_10_cashier_friction_points.summary: Cash session 'open' dialog can be dismissed via backdrop click — cashier can sell WITHOUT a session, cash payments fall into wrong audit flow.
top_10_cashier_friction_points.recommendation: Disable backdrop dismiss when initial-mode='open' OR show persistent 'Aucune session caisse ouverte' banner.

top_10_cashier_friction_points.summary: PosCounterCollectModal does NOT support multi-tranche split. Customer at counter who wants split cash+card has no path — cashier must abandon kiosk order + manually rebuild in POS direct sale.
top_10_cashier_friction_points.recommendation: V1.0.2 backend confirmCounterPaymentSplit endpoint + extend modal.

top_10_cashier_friction_points.summary: Switching CASH/CARD → MULTI mode in PaymentComponent loses any already-typed amount. Pre-populate first tranche.
top_10_cashier_friction_points.recommendation: Carry over cashReceivedRaw into tranches[0].amount when toggling to multi.

Hero amount FR currency format `4.90€` instead of `4,90 €` (virgule + nbsp). LOCK_PAY draft pending owner countersign 10+ days.
top_10_cashier_friction_points.recommendation: Owner countersign LOCK_PAY + apply Intl.NumberFormat fix.

top_10_cashier_friction_points.summary: Customer search defaults to NAME — common cashier scenario is 'customer says 06...'. Phone search would be more useful default.
top_10_cashier_friction_points.recommendation: Add phone-search predicate to vue-select OR toggle between name/phone search modes.
